item.title: Centre Notifies New Solid Waste Management Rules, Effective April 1
item.description: New Delhi, Jan 29: The Centre has notified new Solid Waste Management Rules, making four-stream segregation of waste at the source mandatory and clearly defining responsibilities for bulk waste generators.
